title: Zongzi
description: Zongzi is a China dish made with glutinous rice, ground pork, shiitake mushroom, light soy sauce. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Banana leaves replace bamboo or reed leaves for a home-style zongzi.

steps.instruction: Soak the listed rice, grains or noodles in clean water for about 180 minutes as appropriate, then drain; grind rice and urad for batter if required by this dish.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Fold clean banana leaves into cones; pack soaked sticky rice with seasoned pork filling, close firmly and tie to form zongzi parcels.
Steam the prepared portions in a covered steamer over gently boiling water for about 155 minutes until completely cooked or set, then remove carefully.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
